title: Create Akamai API Client
content:
Akamai API Client is currently not in use. To be able to administrate Akamai services via CLI an API Client is needed. To create a API Client follow steps below. Note this is not needed if only upload to NetStorage using Akamai CDN services.

Set up client via Identity and Access Mgmt using the “advanced track“

Give meaningful name for api client

per CP code?

per project?

personal? what happens when toke expires?

Clear all existing API access.

And add READ-WRITE for CCU APIs.

CCU the only api needed?

Finally review and hit create:

Don’t forget to copy the values to pertinent Azure Key Vault.

delete api?

Add Akamai CLI credentials to Azure Key Vaults

client_secret = add as Azure Key Vault secret AkamaiClientSecret

host = add as Azure Key Vault secret AkamaiHost

access_token = add as Azure Key Vault secret AkamaiAccessToken

client_token = add as Azure Key Vault secret AkamaiClientToken
